records.question: Is Extended Stay America Indianapolis - Plainfield pet friendly?
records.exact_quote: Yes. Extended Stay America Indianapolis - Plainfield offers pet-friendly rooms, so you can bring your furry companion along for your stay.
records.why: the property FAQ affirms pet-friendliness but names NO operative term -- no fee, weight, species or count. The committed reader (indianapolis_founder_review_013 _ALLOWS/_REFUSES) matches neither an allow nor a refusal on this text, so HOLD is the reader-consistent classification, not a judgement call made here. A slogan is not a policy.
